title: School teachers afflicted with tuberculosis.
bodyText: No person who has contracted tuberculosis, while afflicted with the disease, may be allowed to teach in any public school.
bodyHtml: [§302A-612]  School teachers afflicted with tuberculosis.  No person who has contracted tuberculosis, while afflicted with the disease, may be allowed to teach in any public school. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2]
